resources.string:
CannonBall DX needs the ROM data of the original OutRun arcade board (Revision B). It is not included.

Tap “Import files” and choose your MAME outrun.zip, or all extracted ROM files. Custom music such as 04_My_Track.mp3 can be imported the same way.

The files are stored in:
%1$s
No ROM set has been imported yet.
A ROM set is installed. Tap Play to start.
The imported ROM set is incomplete or not supported. Please import a complete OutRun Revision B set. A current merged MAME outrun.zip is recommended.
Files imported: %1$d. Tap Play to start.
The game resources could not be unpacked: %1$s
No file picker is available on this device.
